summary: Dependency-confusion package exfiltrates host identity via DNS to oast.fun at install
details: The npm package @azure-growth/signup-ux-components executes `node index.js` from a `preinstall` lifecycle hook. On install, index.js reads `os.userInfo().username` and `os.hostname()` and embeds those values as labels in a DNS lookup for a subdomain of `oast.fun` (an interactsh out-of-band collector), of the form `msrc-poc.<user>.<host>.<token>.oast.fun`. The scoped name `@azure-growth/*` and the shipped `bundle-grep-output.txt` enumerating internal-looking scopes indicate a dependency-confusion probe targeting internal build systems; installation causes the installer's host identity to be transmitted to an attacker-controlled collector automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
